chunks: O Allah, forgive me for what I sought nearness to Thee with my tongue, but my heart opposed and did not perform it.
ai.seo_question: What does Imam Ali ask Allah to forgive in this supplication regarding the heart and tongue?
ai.summary: This supplication highlights the Shia emphasis on *ikhlas* (sincerity), addressing the common spiritual struggle where ritual observance lacks internal presence of heart. It reflects the nuanced understanding of *nifaq* (hypocrisy) not just as a major sin, but as a subtle discrepancy between outward action and inward belief, urging divine mercy for those whose tongues precede their hearts.
